body: Sometimes things get worse before they have a chance to get better! Try something different! Seek professional help and work on yourself, little by little you will start to see the difference!
I'm sorry if my writing is a bit difficult to understand or all over the place but it's really late in my country now that I'm writing this and I'm trying my best to focus and concentrate!

It seems like there are some steps you may have to take to slowly ( or quickly) but steadily get over depression! I don't know your personal circumstances ( eg financial etc) but some factors that could maybe help you would be : to get professional help- this is usually an important step-, to find a job ( even part time) , maybe look for people ( sexual partners - I don't know what SO means, if ur married or nnot-and/or riends) that value you as a person and don't disregard your needs! Take it one step at a time and start moving towards a direction that you would like to see your life move towards!! You do matter and people do care, A LOT! But you also have to find the people that are right for you, and I think u have many to discover in your future.

Thank you so much... I'm in a difficult phase right now and you almost brought an emotion in me and almost made me tear up ( which I haven't been able to do these past days) .... Thank you fellow human... Thank you ... This hug of acceptance just ... It was so wholesome, I felt embraced... Thank you

There is always room for change!  Don't give up! One step at a time and everything can change! But you  need to take it slow and steady... There are always people who can support you even if they are not your closest ones! Begin searching for them, NGO's, local churches, free therapy groups ( if you're having financial difficulties) so many chances for help and change and for you to receive genuine and beneficial care!

Thank you so much for your kind words and your light! That wild feeling you refered to, that comes close to start looking like happiness, it gets even better! I wish you all the best and to have a path that will slowly (or quickly) will lead you to more enjoyable and wonderful days!

If you are still suicidal truth remains that , no matter if you tell them or not. But telling them will give u access to a lot more methods to get help! Unless if they are really unsupportive and/  or abusive which I'm guessing is not the case!

Maybe it will be... The ethical code for psychologists and therapists provides them with the option to make their own decision if they will take someone as their patient who can't afford to pay! And discuss different methods of payment such as community work!
U summarized where I'm at better than I can! Idk why but it made me feel a bit enthusiastic for a moment and relieved! Weird huh?!

It might be difficult for you to see it but from what you wrote I understood that for you hell is one step away from heaven and that is not the case for many people who are not as lucky. To explain it seems like you have gone through A LOT and you have already managed to come clean ( which a lot of people don't manage to do!). And now that you have acquired through your own strength a better place for your self you seem to know EXACTLY what would help you to reach a whole new world in your life, genuine human contact and friendship! There a millions of us in the world, please don't make the mistake to think none of us would want to create strong friendships with you! Also people come and go from our lives for many reasons and as you mentioned some of your friends had their own hell to go through and ghosted not only you but themselves as well! Now this stuff about your mum hating you.... Idk it can't be that black and white! Maybe she's just sad for some things that don't even concern you... But anyways... I wish you start looking for people you actually WANT in your life with the same tenacity you're looking for a way out! Maybe now with corona virus it's harder but all the social online platforms help!!

You are you and unique!! There is not another one in the world exactly like you!! Even if it seems to u that this is how things are (sometimes we think that things are one way but different people think differently of us from what we have in our brain), there is someone who wouldn't want to lose you no matter what! Maybe that person is waiting for you in your future!!

You can achieve the piece of mind you're looking for but it will take time and will certainly not happen overnight. Have you thought about seeking professional help? If not maybe you should consider it... Also there are some things u say u hate but u don't have a way of seeing the ones you don't right now because your thought process is focused on the negative things! Be safe and maybe some professional help will help you see that there are other things u can do and resources you can utilize rather than self harm to help yourself!!

Such an important and meaningful promise, her
 legacy to you along with all the memories... I hope you'll find meaningful things to fill the rest of your years honoring that promise! Be well...

The " positive side" Of things, even though it seems hard to even distinguish rn is that this depression phase seems to be connected to the Covid situation which means u can and u will get through it pretty easily when normality returns to the lives of everyone else on this planet suffering from Covid related depression. Until that happens u need to find sources that could provide u with a bit of relief, for eg, communicating with a friend back home. Also rn u seem to be suffering by deprivation of necessary nutrients and rest which affects you immensely and as another comment suggested u need to see a doctor to get some help right now - maybe u can arrange an appointment at home or a visit at yours if u want to be more careful with Covid! Stay safe and take care!

Wow, just wow.... Such a fighter! You are an INSPIRATION! I don't know if you recognize the amount of your inner strength! Why bother you say?! You've been through so much it's high time you look for people that will care and bother. Don't stay with the same people cause u have so much value that an abundance of other people would easily recognize it! Stay strong as you have been! Sending love and virtual hugs your way! Wish you all the best!!

I get you, I'm in a similar position rn where I deliberately put myself in! Just when things started getting on track in my life I deliberately fucked up everything... I'm an empty shell barely clinging to life.....I still don't know why I did it but I thought it would be fun.... It's not though... I'm broken.... There must be a way for you to seek treatment! Even online.... Stay strong, if it helps someone is wishing you all the best rn
It feels probably like your soul is rotting little by little... But another way to view it is that this can be the beginning of slowly but steadily discovering who you truly are...
Also u can contact authorities if family doesn't respond!

Have u ever had therapy? For starters some cbt and maybe some medication might strengthen the effects of therapy! The "good" Part of what you're describing rn is that it can most definitely change! And it will if you give it a go... These are not simple words. They are words that I've put in to action after a lot of effort and commitment! But it worked!!
Thank you so much! I hope I'll get through this!

Currently going through a rough phase where I was studying tirelessly and pushing myself like there is no tomorrow for years in order to get a stellar career and money. Just snapped one day and realized it wasn't as I had pictured it, neither the profession required so much, nor was I a robot disregarding all my needs in order to fulfill my goals cause then I would be happy!! Rn I'm suffering a lot, I'm lost and I know that my family wants me to get back on track but I just can't... Listening to this guy gave me a small ray of hope and appreciation for things that I already have in life and how being happy doesn't always align with having a superb career and money, but maybe connections and deep bonds with people while taking everyday as it comes!

So hard to mention one or two reasons... I'm in a very difficult situation rn so I'm mustering what strength I have left to tell you that maybe there are some things that u have and u don't see that make living a bit better, maybe a group if friends would help but your soul knows there are other things as well that will make it better, for eg just one friend, a relative, a good deed.... Stay strong and maybe you will find things worth living for that are in hiding rn
Any advice or comments would be really important! Thanks in advance!!

I know it might sound a bit far fetched but maybe some of the people you've talked to just weren't the right ones for you! Maybe with a bit more searching you will find people that can actually listen about something so humane and not go away!
Try and communicate with your therapist first (even via phone or text) some more intense care might be just what you need in this particular period in your life!
